addDescription: Create a new offer for your telecom catalogue.
basicInfoDescription: Describe the offer and choose the operators it applies to.
title: Offer Title
operatorsDescription: Select one or more operators this offer is available for.
badgesDescription: Optional highlights shown on the offer card.
pricingCommissionDescription: Set pricing and the commission paid to resellers or agents. The selling price is calculated automatically.
sellingPriceDescription: Calculated from the regular price and discount.
inventoryScheduleDescription: Control stock and when the offer is available.
profitSummaryDescription: Estimated profit after company cost and the applicable commission.
deleteConfirmDescription: "{title}" will be removed from the catalogue. This action cannot be undone.
operatorAndTypeDescription: Choose the operators this offer applies to and its offer type.
packageQuantityDescription: Define the package amount and how long the offer stays valid.
pricingDiscountDescription: Set the regular price and optional discount. The selling price is calculated automatically.
commissionSectionDescription: Configure the purchase cost and the commission paid to resellers and agents.
inventoryDescription: Control whether the offer has limited or unlimited stock.
stockQuantityDescription: Number of packages available for this offer.
scheduleStatusDescription: Set when the offer runs and its administrative status.
selectDate: Select a date, then set the time below.
